sources.title: KV Cache Quantization: What FP8 and q8_0 Cost in Accuracy
sources.snippet: The cause was imprecise FP32 accumulation inside Hopper FP8 Tensor Cores once the contraction dimension passes roughly 100K, and a two-level accumulation fix brought it back to 89%. That is KV cache quantization accuracy loss in its purest form: a config change costing 78 points on a retrieval task while every dashboard stays green.
